recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the FHIR-10621 semantics and removes stale path names that would otherwise mislead readers of the current CarePlan StructureDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-10621 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU2 after Patient Care considered whether CarePlan.activity.detail.category should be bound to an external code system. The accepted resolution replaced the old category element with an inline activity kind code, 0..1, with a required binding to a filtered resource-type value set and retained the requirement that kind may determine permitted extensions.
initial_application: The historical implementation commit 96ea9f40cb80fdaebe3f1e29e72447fa55a5ea8a is explicitly tagged '#10621 - removed CarePlan.activity.detail.category and added CarePlan.activity.detail.kind' and added the Care Plan Activity Kind value set. Current source already carries the kind element and required binding, with the value set updated from ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest through later resource renames.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-14817 later rejected removing detail.kind as redundant because the inline detail/reference alternatives were mutually exclusive. FHIR-26064 later renamed activity.detail/reference to plannedActivityDetail/plannedActivityReference. Separate combined-branch reconciliation commits already exist for FHIR-26064 and FHIR-39101, so this run did not publish duplicate decisions for them.
reconciliation: Changed source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml so the active CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.kind definition refers to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference instead of stale pre-R5 CarePlan.activity.detail and CarePlan.activity.reference names. No binding, value-set membership, cardinality, or examples were changed.
source_changes: source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml: updated CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.kind definition text to current element paths.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change decision confirming detail.kind was not redundant while inline detail/reference alternatives were mutually exclusive.
Published later CarePlan rename from activity.detail/reference to plannedActivityDetail/plannedActivityReference; already represented separately on the combined branch.
Later CarePlan planned-activity-detail work is already represented separately on the combined branch and was not re-decided here.
